specimen: studies/kirsch_reference/spec.json case nominal; claim hoop stress sigma_theta_theta at the artifact's own hole boundary x=a, y=0, in MPa
budgets: Reuse studies/development_compute/manifest.json faults unchanged: magnitudes, claim_tolerance_fraction, bounded_observation_error_fraction, boundary_search and decision rule. Scale is the absolute nominal hoop claim.
numerical_budget: studies/kirsch_reference/spec.json budgets.stress_route_abs_MPa evaluated at the changed artifact's remote stress, added to the bounded observation error as the retained cylinder budget is.
eligibility: Nominal and each changed artifact must pass every registered gate in studies/kirsch_reference/run.py case_result; a failure raises and blocks that fault class. Numerical eligibility is provisional, never admission.
truth: Exact rational 3*sigma from the specification's claim.exact_reference; the binary64 route claim must agree within the numerical budget. Null space is observed from exact signal differences, never assigned from a parameter name.

controls.nuisance: density_kg_per_m3 metadata added; the model has no body force
controls.benign_refinement: inapplicable: the claim is closed-form and the quadrature levels enter only the free-body gates

retained_sweep: Rerun the three retained development-compute fault studies in the same execution and record whether their boundaries reproduce the committed reports/development-compute/results.json; that file is not rewritten.
exposure: Public development only; no label, reserved family, benchmark score or new admission
